q: Measure equivalence (ME) of groups Γ and Λ (Gromov's notion): they are ME if they have commuting, measure-preserving, free actions on a standard measure space Σ with finite-measure fundamental domains. This is related to OE by:
opts: OE of free ergodic actions implies ME: if Γ ↷ X and Λ ↷ X are OE free ergodic, then Γ and Λ are ME
exp: Furman's theorem: if two free ergodic actions Γ ↷ X and Λ ↷ X are orbit equivalent, then Γ and Λ are measure equivalent (as abstract groups). This reduces orbit equivalence questions to group-theoretic (ME) questions. Gaboriau's l²-Betti number theorems then give ME invariants.
